title: Dibromo-Edaravone Induces Anti-Erythroleukemia Effects via the JAK2-STAT3 Signaling Pathway.
authors: Chen, Qiqing; Liu, Sheng; Wei, Xuenai; Zhao, Peng; Tian, Fen; Yang, Kang; Song, Jingrui; Huang, Yubing; Wen, Min; Song, Jialei; Jian, Yong; Li, Yanmei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物D-EDA通过JAK2-STAT3信号通路诱导红白血病细胞凋亡，属于纯药理学与细胞实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute erythroid leukemia (AEL) is a rare and aggressive hematological malignancy managed with chemotherapy, targeted therapies, and stem cell transplantation. However, these treatments often suffer from limitations such as refractoriness, high toxicity, recurrence, and drug resistance, underscoring the urgent need for novel therapeutic approaches. Dibromo-edaravone (D-EDA) is a synthetic derivative of edaravone (EDA) with unreported anti-leukemic properties. In this study, D-EDA demonstrated potent cytotoxicity against HEL cells with an IC(50) value of 8.17 +/- 0.43 muM using an MTT assay. Morphological analysis via inverted microscopy revealed reductions in cell number and signs of cellular crumpling and fragmentation. Flow cytometry analysis, Hoechst 33258 staining, Giemsa staining, a JC-1 assay, and a reactive oxygen species (ROS) assay showed that D-EDA induced apoptosis in HEL cells. Furthermore, D-EDA induced S-phase cell cycle arrest. Western blot analysis showed significant upregulation of key apoptosis-related proteins, including cleaved caspase-9, cleaved caspase-3, and cleaved poly ADP-ribose polymerase (PARP), alongside a reduction in Bcl-2 expression. Additionally, oncogenic markers such as c-Myc, CyclinA2, and CDK2 were downregulated, while the cell cycle inhibitor p21 was upregulated. Mechanistic studies involving molecular docking, a cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), the caspase inhibitor Z-VAD-FMK, JAK2 inhibitor Ruxolitinib, and STAT3 inhibitor Stattic revealed that D-EDA activates the caspase cascade and inhibits the JAK2-STAT3 signaling pathway in HEL cells. In vivo, D-EDA improved spleen structure, increased the hemolysis ratio, and extended survival in a mouse model of acute erythroleukemia. In conclusion, D-EDA induces apoptosis via the caspase cascade and JAK2-STAT3 signaling pathway, demonstrating significant anti-leukemia effects in vitro and in vivo. Thus, D-EDA may be developed as a potential therapeutic agent for acute erythroleukemia.
abstract_zh: 急性红白血病（AEL）是一种罕见且侵袭性的血液恶性肿瘤，目前采用化疗、靶向治疗和干细胞移植进行治疗。然而，这些治疗常面临难治性、高毒性、复发和耐药性等局限性，凸显了对新型治疗方法的迫切需求。二溴依达拉奉（D-EDA）是依达拉奉（EDA）的合成衍生物，其抗白血病特性尚未见报道。在本研究中，通过MTT实验，D-EDA对HEL细胞表现出强效细胞毒性，IC(50)值为8.17 ± 0.43 μM。倒置显微镜下的形态学分析显示，细胞数量减少，并出现细胞皱缩和碎裂的迹象。流式细胞术分析、Hoechst 33258染色、Giemsa染色、JC-1实验和活性氧（ROS）实验表明，D-EDA诱导HEL细胞凋亡。此外，D-EDA诱导S期细胞周期阻滞。Western blot分析显示，关键凋亡相关蛋白显著上调，包括cleaved caspase-9、cleaved caspase-3和cleaved poly ADP-ribose polymerase（PARP），同时Bcl-2表达降低。此外，致癌标志物如c-Myc、CyclinA2和CDK2下调，而细胞周期抑制剂p21上调。涉及分子对接、细胞热位移实验（CETSA）、caspase抑制剂Z-VAD-FMK、JAK2抑制剂Ruxolitinib和STAT3抑制剂Stattic的机制研究表明，D-EDA在HEL细胞中激活caspase级联反应并抑制JAK2-STAT3信号通路。在体内实验中，D-EDA改善了急性红白血病小鼠模型的脾脏结构，增加了溶血率，并延长了生存期。总之，D-EDA通过caspase级联反应和JAK2-STAT3信号通路诱导凋亡，在体外和体内均表现出显著的抗白血病效应。因此，D-EDA可能被开发为急性红白血病的潜在治疗药物。
